notes:
Detailed 3D generation now samples the shape at twice the linear resolution and keeps up to 1.35 million triangles. The studio saves the textured high-resolution mesh and uses that same revision for its preview, filament colors, and exports.

On an RTX 3060 the image-based owl produced 1334370 triangles and the wall-mounted cup holder produced 1308684. Both reopened with four textured views. On the same decoded owl surface, the 95th-percentile distance from 32,000 sampled points to the simplified surface changed from 0.063 mm to 0.0074 mm at a 100 mm model size. STL, full-color 3MF, and four-filament 3MF were inspected for geometry and color data where applicable.

Source commit dccf9d5331aad75b3496b56fc5004d157f5d92bd.
